description: This source file defines the ContextAwareTaskDecorator class, which implements Spring's TaskDecorator interface. Its purpose is to decorate Runnable tasks with thread context propagation and cleanup, specifically in the context of the Fineract project. It retrieves the current FineractContext, propagates it to a new thread, and ensures cleanup after execution.

classes.name: ContextAwareTaskDecorator
classes.description: A Spring TaskDecorator implementation that captures the current FineractContext and propagates it to a new thread during task execution, ensuring thread-local context consistency in asynchronous processing.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Wraps a Runnable task to initialize thread context before execution and reset it afterwards, using the captured FineractContext.
